root_causes: Entity/semantic search for '虎先锋' is inherently ambiguous: the game reuses the 'Tiger Vanguard' name for at least 2 distinct boss encounters (an earlier 'Grey Uncle' mini-boss at ~16050s and the true target 'Demon King' boss at ~18000s); rollouts 0 and 2 anchored on the wrong one entirely

transferable_lessons: When a named boss/enemy recurs multiple times in the video (as flagged by multiple distinct entities rows with non-overlapping time ranges), always cross-check the SPECIFIC victory/defeat text or objective text in episodes/topic_facts (e.g. the exact overlay string '已击败 妖王·虎先锋' vs '已击败 灰伯·虎先锋') before picking a clip_qa window, rather than trusting the top semantic_search score alone

For 'how many times during defeating X' counting questions, first locate the exact single successful/final attempt boundary (look for resets, screen-to-black transitions, or repeated encounter text) and restrict the visual sub-agent question to exactly that boundary, not a padded superset window

For fast-action skill-counting questions, split the target window into short, non-overlapping segments (aligned to the true fight boundaries) and ask clip_qa to enumerate distinct activation timestamps rather than just a total count, so the calling agent can audit/dedup and catch obviously short/missed cues instead of trusting an unverified aggregate number

When multiple clip_qa calls on adjacent/overlapping windows are used to cover one continuous fight, explicitly de-duplicate boundary-straddling activations rather than summing per-call counts blindly (rollout 0's triple-call approach likely double-counted transition-boundary activations)
